items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Who was in the Meilenburg job with Hickman? ... Louie Gallo, myself, on trumpet, and I think it was Albert George who played a drummer.

ctx.x: No, no. I think before I got started, he passed.
Oh, he used to play saxophone, he used to play with Rene.
